map.UUID v4 生成器。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: UUID v4 Generator. Built for developers, runs purely in the frontend; your code never leaves the browser.
map.UUID v4 完全由随机数构成：128 位中取 122 位为密码学安全随机值，: UUID v4 is entirely random: 122 of 128 bits are cryptographically secure random values; the other 6 are fixed — bits 13–16 hold version 0100 (so the 15th character is always 4) and bits 65–66 hold variant 10 (the 20th character is always 8/9/a/b). The 122-bit space is about 5.3×10³⁶, collision probability negligible (about 10⁻¹⁸ when generating 1 billion UUIDs). v4 is unordered; as a DB primary key it causes index page splits — use ULID or UUID v7 when ordered IDs are needed.
map.给会话、订单或临时资源分配标识：纯随机、不含任何业务信息，适合需要不可预测性的场: Assign IDs to sessions, orders or temporary resources: purely random, carrying no business info, suited to unpredictability.
map.能用来做 URL 里的防遍历标识吗？: Can it be used as an unguessable ID in URLs?
map.可以，122 位随机空间使枚举在实践上不可行，比自增 ID 安全得多。但它不能替: Yes, the 122-bit space makes enumeration practically infeasible, far safer than an auto-increment ID. But it cannot replace authorization: an unguessable ID only raises the cost, and once leaked (logs, share links, Referer) it is fully exposed. The right design has both layers: unguessable ID + server-side authentication.
